title: FastaLake paper repository: code and source data for every figure and number
description: Code, notebooks, source data and provenance that regenerate every figure panel and every printed number of the manuscript "FastaLake selects compact metaproteomic databases from large sequence reservoirs by de novo peptide lookup" (version v28f).
